subject: actionLink("foo")  in a renderFoo, no corresponding input$foo?

messages.author: bdb7eff1fb889798
messages.subject: actionLink("foo")  in a renderFoo, no corresponding input$foo?
parts:
Hi all, this is based on https://github.com/rstudio/leaflet/issues/89.

Normally when you put an actionLink("foo", ...)  in the ui.R, you will have a corresponding input$foo to work with.

But what if you place an actionLink("bar", ...) in the server.R inside a renderSomething, such as in a popup in a renderLeaflet:

leaflet() %>% addTiles(options= list(minZoom =13)) %>% addPopups(data = pin(), lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, popup = as.character(actionLink("foo", "fooLabel")))

Would someone please shed some light on how to make actionLink usable in such a case?

Thank you very much.

andrew

PS: in a normal actionLink set up in the UI.R, its html shows:
<a id="foo" href="#" class="action-button shiny-bound-input" style="color: blue">fooLabel</a>

but the one in the popup:

<a id="foo" href="#" class="action-button">fooLabel</a>

Could this be a hint?
